messages:
sam: Heads-up: paging middleware (alert-relay) started dropping outbound pages around 02:14 UTC. Incident-bot shows deliveries marked as "suppressed" and no PD pages went out for several customers. Anyone actively looking?

maya: I'm oncall. seeing gaps in the dashboard, e.g. 02:14-02:22 window where delivered_count -> 0 for relay-prod. Are we seeing a deploy?

eli: I spotted a deploy to alert-relay ~02:12, but CI said green. Looking at logs now.

incident-bot: [ALERT] alert-relay:deliveries.suppressed > 10 for service=relay-prod region=us-west at 2026-03-17T02:15:07Z :pager:

nina: Logs show a TTL-check error repeatedly: 
```
2026-03-17T02:14:11Z relay-prod ERR ttl_check failed key=page:abcd123 expire=0 expected>0
2026-03-17T02:14:11Z relay-prod WARN enqueue suppressed due to ttl sink
```

sam: That TTL-check message looks new. Could be the new dedupe/ttl optimization from the deploy. Eli, can you revert or flip a feature flag?

eli: I'm flipping feature flag "relay_dedupe_ttl_enabled" to false now. Doing a single-host flip to test.

ops-bot: deploybot started restart:alert-relay/worker-12 at 2026-03-17T02:16:02Z

maya: After flag flip, PD pages are resuming for one customer. Still seeing intermittent suppressed logs though.

eli: Rolling full rollback to previous revision (v2026.3.11) across relay-prod. ETA ~4m.

deploybot: rollback initiated for service alert-relay in prod (rev -> v2026.3.11) by eli at 02:17:23Z

nina: After rollback, logs look cleaner: 
```
2026-03-17T02:21:40Z relay-prod INFO enqueued page id=xyz123 route=PD success=true
```

sam: Good — manual verification with PagerDuty outbound receipts shows pages delivered between 02:21-02:25.

maya: Customer impact: initial window ~02:14-02:21. Ops telemetry shows 12 customers with missed/outbound-suppressed flags, 5 of those on our SLA tier. We need to notify affected contacts.

eli: Root cause preliminary: a TTL edge-case introduced by dedupe optimization where expired keys were treated as permanent sinks until a restart/feature flip. Fix PR underway to change logic to treat expire=0 as "no-dedupe" instead of sink.

sam: Action items:
- ops: follow up w/ PD contacts for the 5 SLA customers (maya)
- eng: postmortem and link to PR (eli + nina)
- infra: add smoke test for relay TTL semantics in staging (sam)

maya: I'll start outreach template: short incident note + ETA for followup.

nina: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alert-relay/pull/548 (fix ttl semantics). Added unit + integration test.

eli: Deploy plan: stage rollout to canary (2 hosts) -> monitor 10m -> gradual. Will schedule canary for 03:10 UTC.

incident-bot: Event archived: alert-relay.suppressed-pages duplicated detection. Initial severity: P2.

sam: Misc notes: we had fallback SMS path but it was disabled for a subset of customers (legacy flag). For future, consider temporary enabling fallback on deploy-failure detection window.

maya: Logged customer outreach list in #incidents-ops-runbook and pinged CS for templated emails.

eli: Will add a post-deploy smoke step to CI: send synthetic page and assert PD receipt within 30s.

nina: Putting a retro on the calendar for 48h with SRE/eng/CS to review runbook and automation guardrails.

maya: Thanks all — marking this thread as stabilized. Will update once outreach finished. :thumbsup:
